Links

In an effort to bring back the old internet and share quality content site to site, rather than relying on search engines and algorithms, I have created this page to share several of the sites that I enjoy to interact with. You will notice a strong bias towards independent writers and bloggers, as I don't enjoy reading news andior editorial content from large organizations who's loyalties can be difficult to nail down.

I heavily utilize RSS to get updates from all of the sites below, and if you desire to do so you can simply download the full .ompl file that I've exported from my RSS reader of choice: Net News Wire. Additionally I use a service called Kill the Newsletter to turn some of the newsletters here into an RSS feed that I can read.
